name: B10-0059/2024 (Renew) – The devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and its requests after the September 2024 floods in Central and Eastern Europe. It asks the European Commission and Member States to give the EU Civil Protection Mechanism more money and better tools, to spend more on flood prevention and climate adaptation, and to help affected regions rebuild quickly. It also calls for stronger cross-border river planning and better flood defences.

- The Parliament asks for more money and resources for EU disaster response and flood prevention.
- It affects EU countries hit by floods, especially Romania, Poland, Austria, Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary, Germany and Moldova.
- Next, the Commission and Member States are asked to act on these requests; nothing changes automatically.
